title: A Tier-2 city just expanded its metro network - no fanfare, just 11 new stations
sources: GKToday - Indore Metro Priority Corridor-2 Inaugurated
Swarajya Mag - Indore Metro Priority Corridor-2 Inaugurated, Network Expands To 16 Operational Stations Covering Around 17 Km

scenes.text: A Tier-2 city just expanded its metro network.

On September 6, 2026, Indore inaugurated Priority Corridor-2 of its metro - an 11 km stretch with 11 new stations running from Super Corridor-3 to Malviya Nagar Chauraha, built at a cost of roughly Rs 2,850 crore.

scenes.narration: On September sixth, twenty twenty-six, Indore inaugurated Priority Corridor two of its metro - an eleven kilometre stretch with eleven new stations, built at a cost of roughly two thousand eight hundred and fifty crore rupees.

scenes.text: The expansion pushed Indore Metro's total operational network to roughly 17 km across 16 stations - modern urban rail reaching a Tier-2 city, not just India's traditional metro capitals.

scenes.text: Regular passenger service on the extended route began the same day, inaugurated by Union Minister Manohar Lal alongside Madhya Pradesh's Chief Minister.

caption:
A Tier-2 city just expanded its metro network. No fanfare, just 11 new stations.

On September 6, 2026, Indore inaugurated Priority Corridor-2 of its metro - an 11 km stretch with 11 new stations running from Super Corridor-3 to Malviya Nagar Chauraha, built at a cost of roughly Rs 2,850 crore. The expansion pushed Indore Metro's total operational network to roughly 17 km across 16 stations.

Metro rail used to mean Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru. Indore just added itself to that list, one corridor at a time.

Sources: GKToday, Swarajya Mag (2026)
